svg.title: The budget takes from linked threads first
svg.desc: Left: three threads in the store, the one the agent works on and two linked to it, each a list of posts of different lengths. Right: the prepared context keeps every post of the agent's own thread whole, and leaves out the oldest posts of the linked threads. Its second line says which case applies. Own posts are shortened only past three times the budget.
svg.text: One bar per post, as long as the post.
The thread the agent works on
A budget of 3,000 tokens by default.
The thread the agent works on
The second line of the document says which of three cases
applies: complete, this thread complete and linked threads
Posts of the agent's own thread are shortened only past
three times the budget, 9,000 tokens at the default.
